General

Cookie Info & Loading
May I assist you with anything?* What a horrific mess!*
Now, where did this Cookie go...* I beg your pardon, but I really should go...*
Let us make haste to the party. Have we fallen under a wandering spell cast by the moonlight?
How fortunate to have been invited to the Pumpkin Moon Party... There seems to be more guests than were properly invited.
Do you truly believe Cookies are the only ones lost...? Our path will remain well lit as long as my candle continues to burn.
Tired

Lobby

Daily Reward
Welcome to the Pumpkin Moon Party.
Tap
After you. I've prepared all the candies, Jellies, and sweet pies for the party. Someone's foul jokes may have led you astray...

Do you... think I look like Blackberry Cookie? Seems you found something interesting on your adventures. I would recognize you anywhere.
Have you come for the Pumpkin Moon Party? Sometimes the moonlight is not enough to light one's way...
I felt like I was lost and wandering... Whether meeting me is a blessing or a curse will become clear over time...

Neutral I'll mix this into the candy basket to hand out to Cookies.
